The lava stone grill 140 is an electric grill used for skewers of meat or fish and of natural, healthy, tasty and digestible grilled food.

Like the embers of wood, the lava rocks evenly distribute the heat over the entire cooking grid and absorb fat.

This professional electric grill allows for successive and alternating cooking of fish, meats, sausages without transmission of taste or smell.

The stainless steel fireguard fixed around the electric grill protects from possible cooking splashes.

This electric grill is very easy to clean. The dishwasher-safe lava rocks, the electrical box and the enamelled tray are fully removable.

Features:

  • energy regulator with 10 positions
  • control lights.

The eutectic container is a Gastronorm GN 1/3 container equipped with a refrigerated shell to keep in the open air for 5 hours any preparation of liquid paste according to hygiene and sanitary standards.

Just drop the empty white container in the freezer overnight. At the time of service, simply fill in the refrigerated container with crepe, waffle or any king of batter. The eutectic container of 1.5L capacity is ready for use!

The electric crepe maker CDE 350 is equipped with two Ø350 mm enamelled castiron plates with independent controls. The enamelled coating substantially reduces the seasoning phase, allowing for operation from the first use without the need for tedious weekly maintenance.

This professional unit guarantees homogeneous cooking and excellent temperature transfer through its perfectly smooth plates. The integrated Incoloy heating element ensures constant and precise cooking regulated by a thermostat.

Beyond crepes, the CDE 350 is ideal for preparing buckwheat pancakes, tempuras, chapatis, blinis, fried eggs, vegetables, grilled meat, and Peking duck.

Features:

  • 2 spiral heating elements
  • 2 commutator-thermostats 0-300 °C
  • pilot lights and wooden "T" utensil

The Incoloy spiral heating elements are integrated into the plates for precise thermostat-regulated cooking. This versatile unit is suitable for crepes, pancakes, chapatis, blinis, fried eggs, vegetables, and grilled meats.

The gas crepe machine CFG 400 is equipped with an enameled cast iron plate (Diameter: 400 mm). The enameled coating of the plate substantially reduces the seasoning phase, making it operational from the first use.

The 8-star-shaped burner integrated beneath the plate guarantees homogeneous and precise cooking regulated by thermostat. The smooth surface ensures excellent temperature transfer and real contact cooking for light, golden crepes without caramelization.

This professional equipment is also ideal for buckwheat pancakes, Indian tempuras, Indonesian chapatis, blinis, fried eggs, vegetables, or grilled meat. It features a safety thermocouple that automatically stops gas flow in case of malfunction.

Features:

  • Piezo ignition
  • Regulating button with idle position
  • Safety thermocouple
  • Wooden T to spread the dough
  • Delivered in butane / propane with natural gas injectors

A professional crepe maker is indispensable in producing quality crepes, and so are the right tools for the job! The device must be designed to withstand intensive use, characterized by high power and effective temperature control. Let us take a look at the essential tools needed.

The must-have crepe machine accessories:

  • The round greasing pad: fitted with heat-resistant felt for greasing the plate with sunflower oil.
  • The wooden spreader: essential for shaping thin crepes on the plate; works best when wet.
  • Two stainless steel spatulas: a long spatula to flip the crepe and a triangular one to fold it.
  • Roller Grill CK3 crepe kit: a convenient stainless steel set to keep all tools organized and tidy.

The professional CO 60 egg boiler is a must have equipment for breakfast buffet and brunch. The Gastronorm GN 1/3 egg boiler is an indispensable professional equipment for hotels and restaurants, allowing each customer to prepare eggs at the desired cooking time: softboiled, boiled, or poached.

The Roller Grill egg cooker works like a bain-marie: simply pour water into the GN 1/3 stainless steel tray and immerse your egg basket in boiling water. The powerful heating element and aluminum plate ensure even heat distribution, while the temperature limiter enables safe cooking.

Features:

  • Includes 6 numbered baskets
  • Capacity for up to 10 egg baskets
  • Easy to clean and store

The professional hot dog machine CS 3 E is a fast cooking steamer. After preheating, it can be used continuously all day long to serve up to 60 hot dogs per hour.

This electric steamer is specially designed for steam cooking fresh sausages. It features a glass cylinder (ø 200mm, Height: 240mm) and a heating element under a Teflon container that boils water to create steam.

The machine is easy to use: set the thermostat to "max" for 15 minutes, then switch to the continuous position for nonstop cooking or 70°C to keep warm.

A compartmentalised basket holds up to 40 fresh sausages, while 3 heating pads are included to toast hot dog buns or baguettes.

This compact steam cooker is ideal for sandwich shops, food trucks and small food outlets.

Features:

  • 3 heating pads
  • cylindrical glass envelope
  • teflon tank
  • energy regulator
  • pilot light

The CT 3000 infrared conveyor oven: the champion of the cooking of snacks! The CT 3000 infrared conveyor oven is equipped with 2 ramps of 4 infrared quartz tubes. These infrared quartz spread rays of 1050 ° C on the products. They ensure a quick and fast cooking of the products of your snacks.

This infrared conveyor oven can cook with no preheating and continuously in record time: the cooking time is 1 minute and 30 seconds on average!

The infrared quartz on the upper part is protected by a patented tube cover.

The CT 3000 quartz grill is extremely flexible in use and maintenance! Thanks to its 3 settings, the CT 3000 quartz grill fits all cooking modes and snacks:

  • The speed of rotation of the belt is regulated according to the product to cook or to reheat. The minimum time of pass through is 47 seconds. The maximum time of pass through is 2 minutes and 30 seconds.
  • The 2 quartz ramps can operate at full power or at half power
  • The pass through height can be adjusted between 70 and 110 mm thanks to the stainless reflectors to concentrate the temperature in the cooking chamber and reduce the cooking time.

Very compact, this conveyor toaster is stackable and can be raised thanks to a stainless steel support table (475 x 360 x 300 mm). The control box can be offset on a wall or on a worktop thanks to 1-meter-long-cord.

The top roof keeps warm breads or pastries.

Every kind of snack cooking is possible with the CT 3000 B infrared conveyor toaster! Thanks to its different settings, the CT 3000 B infrared quartz grill allows you to vary and multiply cooking unattended. In a single pass, this conveyor toaster enables you:

  • to toast buns, rolls in 50 seconds,
  • to cook pizzas or quiches (precooked and fresh garnish) in less than 2 minutes depending on the filling,
  • to brown onion soups, cheese-based snacks in 1 minute,
  • to cook toast, bruschetta, sandwiches in less than 2 minutes according to the "topping",
  • to melt fondues or warm up croissants, pastries in 50 seconds!

The maintenance of the conveyor oven is very simple. The carpet is cleaned with a brush. The roof as well as the 2 sliding waste bins placed at the entrance and exit under the belt are completely removable.

The cast-iron contact-grill DOUBLE PANINI is particularly recommended for continuous daily use. It is designed for intensive use, capable of cooking 96 panini per hour. Its cast-iron plates offer high thermic inertia, restoring heat after 15 minutes of preheating for continuous daily operation.

The professional DOUBLE PANINI ensures homogeneous and varied cooking. It consists of 2 PANINI contact-grills integrated into a stainless steel enclosure with independent controls. High-conduction cast-iron plates and serpentine-shaped heating elements ensure even heat distribution across the entire cooking surface.

While specifically designed for high-quantity panini cooking, it is also suitable for toasting sandwiches or cooking steaks. The self-balancing top plates feature adjustable pressure springs to adapt to different foods. This model is also available with a smooth bottom plate for cooking omelettes, fried eggs, cakes, and wraps.

Features:

  • thermo-resistant and metallic handles
  • control lights
  • Comes with a scraper for easy cleaning

Options:
